page.description: pearOS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A Debian-based Linux distribution focused on simplicity and ease of use, originally created by Adrien Beraud.
pros: Debian-based with access to Debian packages
cons: Official website (pearos.net) returns HTTP 404 – project appears abandoned or moved
SourceForge project exists but contains no ISO download files (only a PNG image)
No active download source could be verified for any edition or ISO format
The project site no longer resolves and no ISO is published, so this page lists no images.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for pearOS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Project website is unreachable (404) and no download files are available on any known mirror.
